[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested routes for the Grand Canyon road trip:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Route from Las Vegas to Grand Canyon: Take Highway 64 North to Williams, Arizona (about 2.5 hours), then Highway 180 West to the South Rim (about 1 hour).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Route from Grand Canyon to Monument Valley: Take Highway 64 East to Highway 160 East, then connect to Highway 163 North (about 4 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Route from Monument Valley to Four Corners: Take Highway 163 South to Highway 160 West, then connect to Highway 64 West (about 2.5 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended accommodations in Las Vegas: Budget-friendly motels to luxury resorts, staying on the Strip or in nearby Henderson.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended accommodations at the Grand Canyon: Bright Angel Lodge or Yavapai Lodge, or staying in nearby Williams or Flagstaff.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended accommodations in Monument Valley: Monument Valley Inn or Goulding's Lodge.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended accommodations near Four Corners: Aneth Lodge or Cortez Days Inn.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for the road trip: Pack warm clothing for January, check the weather forecast, be prepared for limited dining options, book accommodations in advance, and bring a camera and binoculars.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional recommendations: Consider visiting Hoover Dam or Petrified Forest National Park, take a guided tour of Monument Valley, and be mindful of time zone changes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested ways to find volleyball leagues or gyms: Google search, USA Volleyball website, local community centers, Meetup.com, Facebook groups, and asking around.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended specific volleyball leagues and gyms in Las Vegas:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Las Vegas Volleyball League (LVVL) offers co-ed and women's leagues.
